paragraphs.text: Note: Anything from any of the tropical biomes can go to anywhere in the tropical dimension
For mob spawning (only natural spawning, not spawn eggs, commands, etc.):
Small fish require water in their spawn block and water in the blocks directly above and below it
Large fish require water in their spawn block and water in the 2 blocks directly above and the 2 directly below it
Bottom fish require water in their spawn block and water in the 2 blocks directly above and a solid block directly below it

For mob spawning (only natural spawning, not spawn eggs, commands, etc.):
Small lava fish require lava in their spawn block and lava in the blocks directly above and below it
Large lava fish require lava in their spawn block and lava in the 2 blocks directly above and the 2 directly below it
Hoglin (zombifies in warped forest, can’t zombify in overworld-like aoemod dimensions because it can’t leave the nether dimension)

Sulfur-colored Cubozoa  (large fish) (requires a separate new mob that uses the same model and texture as sulfur cubozoa, but extends the nether depths fish instead. Keep the sulfur variant of the cubozoa, which won’t spawn in any of the aoemod biomes without commands anyway. That way it doesn’t break the original mod. Rename it to lava jellyfish)

Giant Crimson Fungus (not logs, but wood products can be placed anywhere in the nether but not desert). Logs, wood, nether wart blocks, and crimson fungus must be in the crimson forest. Growing outside of the crimson forest cancels the feature, choosing a lower height when possible instead

Giant Warped Fungus (not logs, but wood products can be placed anywhere in the nether but not desert). Logs, wood, warped wart blocks, and warped fungus must be in the crimson forest. Growing outside of the crimson forest cancels the feature, choosing a lower height when possible instead

Pale Oak (soul sand valley only; logs and wood products can be placed in both nether and desert, but leaves, saplings, and pale hanging moss cannot be placed outside of the soil sand valley. Growth of the tree from a sapling or feature fails if it would grow outside of the biome, choosing a lower height instead of possible
Powder Cane (My Nether’s Delight) (cannot be placed out of or grow out of basalt deltas)

Products made from quartz can be placed anywhere in desert or nether, but the quartz ores are restricted. The same is true for gold ores and gold products. The exception is ancient debris, which can be placed in anywhere in the nether (but not the desert) and generates in all of those biomes. The quantity of these 3 ores are 2-4 times more common in the basalt deltas, because the basalt deltas as no plants or trees (other than the powder cane which makes gunpowder) and all of fish drops non-edible items, so to balance it I want it to have a large mining advantage.
Nether Gold Ore (only placeable when the block above is warped or crimson forest) (replaces netherrack)
Soul soil Gold Ore (only placeable when the block above is soul sand valley) (replaces soul soil)
Soul sand Gold Ore (only placeable when the block above is soul sand valley) (replaces soul sand)
Blackstone Gold Ore (only placeable when the block above is basalt deltas) (replaces blackstone)
Basalt Gold Ore (only placeable when the block above is basalt deltas) (replaces blackstone)
Nether Quartz (only placeable when the block above is warped or crimson forest) (replaces netherrack)
Basalt Nether Quartz (only placeable when the block above is basalt deltas) (replaces basalt)
Blackstone Nether Quartz (only placeable when the block above is basalt deltas) (replaces blackstone)
Soul soil soul Quartz (only placeable when the block above is soul sand valley) (replaces soul soil)
Soul sand soul Quartz (only placeable when the block above is soul sand valley) (replaces soul sand)
Ancient Debris (only placeable in the nether) (on basalt, blackstone, soul sand, soul soil, netherrack)
Can be placed anywhere in the desert or nether, but only generate in the basalt deltas biome
Sulfur (on basalt, blackstone, only generates in blobs that border lava. The blob does not to need to be fully exposed to lava, but it must partially be exposed to lava)

Can be placed anywhere in the desert or nether, but only generates as an ore in the nether biomes. In all nether biomes, it generates like it does in the nether. In the basalt deltas, glowstone also generates as a regular ore like coal (with 0% discard chance)
Surface Land (block above is crimson forest, including caves): 1 crimson nylium
Surface Land (block above is warped forest, including caves): 1 warped nylium
Block above is Crimson or warped forest (and the block is not on the surface): Netherrack
Block above is Soul Sand Valley: 3D noise of soul sand vs. soul soil
Block above is Basalt Deltas: 3D noise of blackstone vs. basalt

Soul sand, soul soil, netherrack, warped nylium, and crimson nylium can only be placed where the biome above them matches the surface builder checks. Blackstone and Basalt can be placed anywhere in the desert or the nether
